value.body: A two-year master's covering probability, statistical inference, regression, sampling, multivariate analysis, stochastic processes and statistical computing. It leads to analytics and data roles, government statistical services and research.

items.label: Entrance routes
items.note: JAM has a Mathematical Statistics paper

value.title: How you get in
value.body: A B.Sc with statistics or mathematics, for most programmes. Admission is through IIT JAM's Mathematical Statistics paper (IITs and some other institutes), CUET-PG (central and many state universities), or university and institute entrance tests such as ISI's.

value.title: At a glance
items: UPSC's Indian Statistical Service and SSC statistics posts (such as Junior Statistical Officer) are common government targets.
Programming skills (R, Python, SQL) weigh heavily in analytics hiring.
Teaching and research usually need UGC-NET or CSIR-NET and a Ph.D.
